gen-gf-revalia-gf-roboto: Wide-striding, loud, and unbothered. Roboto sits underneath with generously open round letters, so the whole thing feels grounded against Revalia's sprawl.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-ruda: Revalia stretches out its tall, widely spaced letters, while Ruda below runs on a wire-thin monoline skeleton. Reading it feels light and easy.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-savate: Savate has a tall rounded o and open curves, with diagonals pressed a touch thinner than its verticals, under Oxanium's big lowercase. They feel like a machine and its friendly manual.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-saira: Spaghetti-thin strokes of one width give Funnel Display its swagger, and its c tips keep a clear gap. Saira follows with see-through s shapes and rounds reaching up high.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-sarpanch: Revalia spreads its tall band of widely separated letters across the line with a loose, confident stride. And Sarpanch keeps a clearly open e and compact ascenders, so a long read stays tidy.
gen-eater-gf-noto-traditional-nushu: Menacing is the mood Eater brings, with its wide gaps and stubby ascenders. Noto Traditional Nushu follows with a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut, so longer reading stays friendly.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Stubby, towering lowercase with a playful swagger. Noto Sans Vithkuqi has open throats and barely any step from capitals to lowercase, so it can sit at a modest size beside Flavors.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Bold is the first word for Autour One, with clear channels into its rounds and no hairline shift anywhere. Noto Sans Wancho's chalky, hulking lowercase gives the pair real weight.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Audiowide sets its tall lowercase like tiles with wide grout lines, one stroke weight throughout. But Noto Sans Deseret's open apertures and wide lowercase give the pair a friendly, legible footing.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-sofia-sans: Commanding letters in Goldman sit widely apart, their round forms like open parentheses. And Sofia Sans, with every stroke the same gauge, keeps a long read smooth and quietly modern.
